capsule_sdf — 3D sdf_csg op

• Data kinds: coordgrid → sdf

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.capsule_sdf(grid, a, b, radius) (to call the implementation directly, import sdf_ops; sdf_ops.capsule_sdf(grid, a, b, radius); from the registry, ops3d.get("capsule_sdf"))

Usage

Exact signed distance field of a capsule formed by thickening the segment a–b by radius radius.

sdf(p) = ‖p - (a + clamp(((p-a)·(b-a))/‖b-a‖², 0, 1)·(b-a))‖ - radius. It is exactly the shortest distance to a segment, so it has gradient norm 1 over all space (unlike a cylinder, its ends are round, so it has no corners and is exact). Suited to approximating ribs, piping, bones, wires and the swept volume of a tool.

Arguments and validation (ValueError):

• grid: float array (..., 3) whose last axis is 3.

• a / b: end points of the core line (3 elements). If a == b it is a sphere (matches sphere_sdf).

• radius: thickness (negative is rejected).

Returns: float64 of shape grid.shape[:-1].

Where to use: to check tool reachability as "does the swept volume of the tool avoid the part?", place the tool as a capsule and check whether the minimum of sdf_intersect is positive. Also for synthesizing trabeculae, vessels and fibres.
